revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.6% (32,667/28,263); fade from 10% toward mid-single digits as growth normalises with the semiconductor cycle; no external guidance used.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 36.9% (12,054/32,667), FY2024 35.2%, FY2023 34.5%; modest expansion to 37.5% held flat.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~16% (pretax 12,158.7 vs net income 10,213.0); rounded up to 17% for conservatism.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 capex/revenue 7.8%, 7.3%, 4.8% (avg ~6.6%); 5.5% reflects capacity investment above D&A.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with ECB 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (2026-11-05), Damodaran Netherlands ERP 4.23% (2026-02-16), assumed relevered beta ~1.2 (not pulled from industry data), cost of equity ~8.3%; net cash and debt <1% of capital so WACC ~ cost of equity.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered from 2.5% to 1.5% (below ECB ~2% inflation target, well below 3.27% risk-free) to reduce reliance on terminal value flagged by review (77% of EV); a 5-year explicit period on a growth company inherently leaves TV as the majority of value.
